Name: stanloona420's Sam Revised for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I recieved a request to finish the rest of stanaloona's revised bachelor's for Seasonal Cute. So here they are!

This one contains [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11149]Sam Revised[/url], now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url]. This includes 2 versions:

1: Slightly less spiky hair
2: More skater-boy style hair

Pick which version you'd like and overwrite your seasonal cute assets with its contents.

All assets used were either open permission or I was granted permission to use. Assets used provided by:
stanloona420
Ailin
Poltergeister

Enjoy!
